items.title: 12.10 Reactions of sulfur (sulfur ke reactions) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.10, printed page 282.

blocks.text: Sulfur bohat se elements se mil kar different (alag alag) qism ke inorganic aur organic compounds banata hai. Aam conditions (halaat) mein yeh pani, dilute non-oxidising acids aur noble gases se react nahi karta. Catenation ki ability (salahiyat) ki wajah se yeh rings aur linear chains (seedhi zanjeer) banata hai. Sulfur ke kuch aham reactions yeh hain:
i. Sulfur hawa mein blue flame (neeli lau) ke saath jal kar SO₂ banata hai. Sulfur ka doosra bara oxide SO₃ hai, jis ke liye zyada temperature aur catalyst (Pt) chahiye.
Nitric acid sulfur ko oxidise kar ke NO₂ aur H₂SO₄ banata hai.

ii. Jab sulfur apne se kam electronegativity wale elements (metals) se react karta hai to oxidising agent ka kaam karta hai aur un ke sulfides banata hai. Yeh Ag, Cu aur Zn par metal sulfide ki teh chadha kar unhen dhundla (tarnish) kar deta hai. Sulfur Au (sona) aur Pt se react nahi karta.
iii. Sulfur cyanide ko thiocyanate mein badal deta hai; thiocyanate ko pseudohalide (halide jaisa ion) bhi kehte hain. Yeh Fe³⁺ ki pehchan (analysis) mein kaam aata hai.

iv. Sulfur F₂ se seedha react kar ke SF₄ aur SF₆ banata hai. Sulfur hexafluoride (SF₆) gas hai aur bohat unreactive hai; bijli ke devices (aalaat) mein insulator gas ke taur par istemal hoti hai. Sulfur Cl₂ se aasani se react kar ke S₂Cl₂ (peela liquid) banata hai, jo aur Cl₂ se mil kar SCl₂ (red liquid) ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Sulfur halogens se kaise react karta hai (exercise Q.2i)?
blocks.explanation: Fluorine se seedha SF₄ aur SF₆ banata hai; SF₆ inert gas hai jo insulator ke kaam aati hai (S + 3F₂ → SF₆). Chlorine se pehle peela S₂Cl₂ (2S + Cl₂ → S₂Cl₂) aur zyada chlorine se red SCl₂ banta hai.

items: S + O₂ → SO₂ (neeli lau); SO₃ ke liye Pt aur garmi; HNO₃ sulfur ko H₂SO₄ banata hai.
Metals (Ag, Cu, Zn, Hg) ke sulfides; Au aur Pt se nahi.
KCN + S → KSCN; F₂ se SF₄, SF₆; Cl₂ se S₂Cl₂ aur SCl₂.
